latency_note: Forward-only wall clock on preprocessed KITTI images. Image loading, preprocessing and NMS are excluded. Exported C++ activation kernels are single-threaded, while native SiLU and the PyTorch C++ LUT may use the configured PyTorch thread count. Activation time uses inner wall-clock timers around all activation calls. With batch > 1, reported latency is batch time divided by batch size.
